cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — standing; A private wardrobe atelier in the station where theatrical dresses are fitted against a glowing mirror — She tests how far she can reach in the fitted outfit; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake at chest height; An orbital ceramics kiosk with drawers of glazed samples and a sunlit viewing niche — She turns a purple test tile under the light to see which part changes from silver to plum; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — dries her hair with a towel; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — perched on a ledge or edge; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — standing; her home kitchen with a counter — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — reclining on her back; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — loops the strap of a camera over her head; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — grinds the ink stick on a calligraphy brush and an ink stone
